journey.name: profile link validation
journey.description: Precondition: a disposable wallet signed in to a Pubky profile with at most four links, PIN off and an English device. This checks that the Add Link sheet in Edit Profile refuses links pubky.app would refuse, with an error on the field that needs fixing, and still accepts a bare domain.

actions.action: Open Profile using "ProfileButton" and wait for "ProfileViewName"
Enter "Website" in "AddLinkLabel" and "not a url" in "AddLinkUrl"
Verify "AddLinkUrlError" says "Enter a valid web link, such as example.com." and "AddLinkSave" is disabled
Verify "AddLinkUrlError" is shown and "AddLinkSave" is disabled
Verify "AddLinkUrlError" is gone and "AddLinkSave" is enabled
Tap "AddLinkSave" and verify a "Website" link with "example.com" appears in Edit Profile
